notes_for_editor: Identity conflict to check before publishing. The brief lists Lobelville as an other name, but the Register page does not use that name. The National Register study lists a Lobelville tower and a Linden tower in Perry County as extant on March 26, 2014; the tower list has Lobelville (7-18) removed and Linden (7-19) standing. The Register coordinates sit roughly 6 km southwest of the Lobelville town coordinates on Wikipedia, which does not settle the question. No access information and no visit report were found. The tower's own status after March 2018 is unknown.
